//: Where production is, for the deploy scripts (tools/deploy/lib/preconditions.mjs reads it; there is no Terraform in this repository). Every value is public: they appear in the deployed bundle, in DNS, or in a URL a player visits. Nothing secret belongs here. A `signaling_url` (https, the Cloud Run service's address) is added when the game has a server deployed; until then the client is built without one, and the page says it is in development.
